name: HWE · Deep clean
description: Targeted pre-spray, suitable agitation with a counter-rotating brush (CRB), then hot water extraction and rinsing. Choose pressure, temperature and tools to suit the carpet. Powered extraction or brushing can be specified where appropriate. Do not promise 220-degree steam: temperature units, equipment settings and fibre suitability must be confirmed.

name: HWE · Standard
description: Hot water extraction using a wand and suitable in-tank cleaning solution, with extraction passes to recover the solution and soil. Separate pre-spray and CRB agitation are not included unless added to the quote.

name: Rotary / encapsulation
description: Low-moisture maintenance cleaning using an appropriate encapsulation product and rotary or suitable brush machine. Soil is encapsulated as the product dries and removed by subsequent vacuuming. Often used for suitable low-pile commercial carpets and carpet tiles; check the carpet manufacturer’s care guidance.

name: Bonnet cleaning
description: Low-moisture surface maintenance using a rotary machine and an absorbent pad. The pad collects loosened surface soil and is changed as it soils. Use only on suitable carpet constructions; this is not the same process as hot water extraction.

name: Rotowash
description: Twin cylindrical contra-rotating brushes work the cleaning solution through the surface, lift the carpet pile and transfer dirty liquid to a separate recovery tank. Suitable brushes and solution must be selected for the carpet or floor.

name: Dry compound
description: A suitable absorbent carpet-cleaning compound is brushed into the pile, allowed to work according to its instructions and thoroughly vacuumed out with the captured soil. Check fibre and construction suitability before quoting.

name: Upholstery
description: Price by seating position for sofas and armchairs. Use the specific chair rates below for smaller chairs. Check fabric, construction and condition before confirming the method and quote.
